info.title: Cloud Agents Identity API
info.description: Browser session facade and separately authenticated server-only Identity Service operations.

get.description: Public closed RS256 verification-key document. Consumers pin issuer and accepted audiences locally and apply revision, validity, and lineage continuity rules.

200.description: Active verification keys and bounded immutable key-lineage authority metadata.

post.description: Authenticated Web-server upstream call. The service identity fixes application purpose; the private response header returns the new opaque session handle. Authentication failures use the same generic problem response.

204.description: Durable session revoked. The Web server separately clears its application cookie.

200.description: Current account display facts; not authorization authority.

get.description: Returns a bounded page of authorized tenant selector projections for this application session. The cursor is opaque and bound to the session and application.

200.description: Authorized selector projection; every resource request still rechecks authorization.

get.description: Admin-purpose only. Rechecks the durable Admin session and current platform-admin or selected-tenant tenant-admin authority.

200.description: Current exact verified-email-domain admission policy. An empty allowedDomains list permits any verified email.

put.description: Admin-purpose only CAS update. The policy restricts later invitation acceptance or membership admission and never grants authority or removes existing members.

200.description: Updated policy after the exact expected resource version is committed.

post.description: Server-only. Service identity fixes application purpose; session and current Control Plane bindings derive principal and scopes.

200.description: Short-lived token returned only to the authenticated Web server.

post.description: Server-only online check for the exact-token digest and verifier-established application/tenant/project context.

200.description: Opaque activity status. The response never returns principal or token material.

post.description: Server-only Identity Service to Control Plane authorization. The Control Plane re-reads the durable session and current bindings, then returns the stable account subject inputs and derived scopes.

200.description: Current principal and scopes derived by Control Plane authority.

get.description: Admin-purpose only bounded invitation page, with a cursor bound to the current session and selected tenant. Never returns invitation proofs or their hashes.

post.description: Admin-purpose only. Validates current tenant administrator authority, selected role and scope, and the current email domain policy. The new proof is returned once; it is never recoverable from listing.

delete.description: Admin-purpose only. Revokes a pending invitation. Repeating a revocation is a no-op; accepted or expired invitations reject the change.

post.description: New account: invitation code, password and display name, with persisted administrator email attestation. Existing account: matching active session plus CSRF, with neither password nor display name. Atomically consumes the invitation and adds the explicitly invited membership/role. Returns no token or new session.
Disables an account and revokes its sessions.

put.description: Changes the authenticated account password and revokes all sessions.

post.description: Consumes a one-use provider reauthentication proof, creates the first password credential, and revokes every session including the current session.

204.description: Password enabled and all sessions revoked.

post.description: Consumes a one-time reset code and revokes all sessions.

get.description: Platform administrator global identity audit metadata.
Tenant administrator identity audit metadata strictly filtered to the selected tenant.
Tenant-scoped identity account metadata for active or suspended memberships.
Lists enabled login providers for the authenticated Admin or User Web service purpose.

post.description: Creates one durable one-use provider flow. Reauth and link require the current application session and CSRF; invitation additionally requires the canonical client IP. Raw state is returned only in a private response header.
Consumes a durable provider flow before exchanging its code. Optional issuer is accepted only for OIDC/GitLab and must match the pinned issuer; sessionState is bounded and non-authoritative.

get.description: Lists the current account login methods and whether it has a password credential.

post.description: Verifies the current password and returns the one-use proof only in a private response header.

delete.description: Consumes a one-use reauthentication proof and unlinks one provider login. The last usable login method cannot be removed.

get.description: Platform-administrator provider configuration list. It contains secret references only.

put.description: Creates or updates one application-specific provider configuration using optimistic resource versioning. Secrets remain operator-controlled references.

post.description: Starts a five-minute CLI loopback authorization. The caller binds an exact loopback port, random state, application purpose, and PKCE S256 challenge.
Browser-session approval. Rechecks the application-bound session and consumes the exact state before returning a one-use code for the bound loopback port.

200.description: Private loopback redirect facts for the Web server.

post.description: One-use authorization-code exchange bound to the original PKCE verifier. Returns a revocable non-browser CLI grant once.

200.description: Revocable CLI grant returned only to the loopback CLI.

get.description: Lists tenants currently authorized for this application and CLI grant.

post.description: Issues a 15-minute CLI-purpose Control Plane token after live RBAC authorization.

delete.description: Revokes the exact CLI grant and all future online admissions of tokens derived from it.

post.description: Issues a 15-minute automation-purpose token from an active single-tenant service-account credential after Control Plane RBAC authorization. No browser client exposes this operation.
Server-only Identity Service to Control Plane authorization for CLI grants or service-account credentials. The Control Plane remains the sole RBAC evaluator.

200.description: Current subject and scopes derived by Control Plane authority.

get.description: Admin session only. Requires current tenant-admin authority and returns only the selected tenant audit facts; historical facts may omit actor and correlation.

200.description: Bounded tenant Control Plane audit page.

ServiceAuth.description: Configured Web or Control Plane service credential; never a browser credential.

SessionHandle.name: X-Cloud-Agents-Session
SessionHandle.description: Opaque durable-session handle forwarded only by an authenticated Web server.

IdentityServiceAuth.description: Dedicated Identity Service to Control Plane credential. It is distinct from Web service and browser credentials.

CLIGrant.name: X-Cloud-Agents-CLI-Grant
CLIGrant.description: Private revocable CLI grant forwarded only by an authenticated Web server; never accepted as browser session or service authentication.

AutomationCredential.name: X-Cloud-Agents-Automation-Credential
AutomationCredential.description: Private revocable service-account credential forwarded only by an authenticated Web server or automation ingress; never accepted as browser session or service authentication.

ClientIP.name: X-Cloud-Agents-Client-IP
ClientIP.description: Canonical single client IP derived by the authenticated Web server from the accepted socket or configured trusted TLS proxy. Lists, ports, zones, whitespace, X-Forwarded-For, and browser-supplied values are forbidden.

ReauthenticationProof.name: X-Cloud-Agents-Reauthentication
ReauthenticationProof.description: Private one-use reauthentication proof forwarded only by the authenticated Web server.

OAuthState.description: Private OAuth state. The Web server binds it to a short-lived HttpOnly flow cookie and never forwards it to browser JavaScript.

ReauthenticationProof.description: Private one-use reauthentication proof. The Web server stores it only in a short-lived HttpOnly cookie.

BrowserSession.description: Application-specific session projection returned to an authenticated Web server.

IdentityLoginSession.description: New session projection plus a private opaque handle for the authenticated Web server. The Web server must not forward this header to the browser.

X-Cloud-Agents-Session.description: Private opaque durable-session handle. Never exposed in browser JSON or response headers.

Problem.description: Stable error response. Authentication failures do not reveal whether an account exists.

ProviderAuthorization.description: Provider authorization URL plus private flow state.

ProviderCallback.description: Closed provider callback result. New session or reauthentication proofs are private headers.

X-Cloud-Agents-Session.description: Private new durable-session handle for login or invitation completion.
